response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web/mobile software engineer with no demonstrated background in SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, AI accelerator design, GPU/SIMD architecture, or deep-learning performance optimization. His skill set (TypeScript, Node.js, web frameworks, DLang, general software craftsmanship) does not align with the highly specialized hardware-software co-design and performance architecture requirements of this Principal-level role.
strengths: Extensive multi-domain software engineering experience (web, mobile, embedded, desktop)
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and community involvement (talks, workshops, open source)
Some low-level systems experience with async I/O, caching, and performance-sensitive microservices at Dunnhumby
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization, GPU, or SIMD/MIMD background
Career trajectory is generalist full-stack/web development, not specialized performance/hardware architecture

key_factors.factor: No deep-learning or GPU workload optimization background
Strong general software engineering seniority and experience
